metadata.fleet_method: Sum of per-route peak overlapping trips with a 15-minute terminal buffer; route interlining is not modeled.
metadata.zone_assignment_rule: Each route is assigned once to the district containing the largest number of its recorded in-area stops. Ties are assigned to North Delhi when present; otherwise the district name is the tie-break.
